Sclerite Studio 0.12.0\n请用0.12或更高版本打开本项目:
Sclerite Studio 0.12.3
Open this project in version 0.12 or later. classification retains manual classes, scores, specimen UUIDs and segmentation identity; export model packages separately. study metadata and original SHA256 hashes are retained.
Result ZIPs and CSVs contain approved objects only. Automatic splitting never reconstructs occlusion; review boundaries and completeness. Projects include pending candidates and plate.json (sizes, pages, background and scale bars); result ZIPs exclude the layout.
Originals: images/<image_id>/original. labels.u32 contains row-major little-endian 32-bit instance IDs; 0 is background. Units: px/px² if uncalibrated, um/um² if calibrated. Length is 2D maximum Feret diameter, not arc length.
Layout preserves relative source size by default. μm scale bars require calibration; individually scaled objects receive separate bars. Layout transformations do not change classifier inputs.
Model suggestions are not manual labels and scores are not true species probabilities. After segmentation or outline changes, labels from old identities are excluded from training. Grouping uses recorded specimens, colonies and originals; reshooting, re-encoding and unrecorded shared sclerites require manual checks. Synthetic examples have synthetic=true.

沿用分割、接触切分与完整性复核。只纳入人工确认的完整骨针；遮挡不补形。按每张照片: Use segmentation, contact splitting and completeness review. Include manually approved intact sclerites only; do not reconstruct occlusion. Convert to μm using each photo’s calibration; do not compare absolute sizes without calibration.

将人工候选分组与既有鉴定、分子谱系分栏保存。下一步在标准化后的标本特征上做 PC: Store candidate groups, previous identifications and molecular lineages in separate fields. Explore standardized specimen features with PCA and cluster-stability analyses. Clusters are not species; UMAP separation is not a delimitation test.
